relatedItems.ja: 1/1000 宇宙戦艦ヤマト3199（第3次改装型：参戦章叙勲式典記念塗装）
relatedItems.en: 1/1000 Space Battleship Yamato 3199 (Third Renovation Type: Painting to Commemorate the Battle Medal Awarding Ceremony)

ja: • 全長約666mm、超弩級ヤマト発進。
• 大きさを生かした作りやすさと2199版の精密なディテールが魅力のビッグスケールプラモデル。
• ディテールアップには『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2199』メカニカルデザインの玉盛順一朗氏を起用。
• 本体は接着剤不要。色分けを完全再現。合わせ目が出ず、かつ組み立てやすいパーツ分割を極限まで追求。
• 第一格納庫の内部を再現。第二格納庫のハッチは開閉可能。第三格納庫の開閉をコンパチで再現。
• 同スケールの艦載機４種×２機が付属。
• 細部を含むマーキングはスライドマークで再現。
成形品×未定、スライドマーク、組立説明書
en: • Approximately 666mm in total length, super-dreadnought Yamato launch.
• A big scale plastic model that is easy to build by taking advantage of its size and has the precision details of the 2199 version.
• Junichiro Tamamori, the mechanical designer for Space Battleship Yamato 2199, was appointed to improve the details.
• No adhesive required for the main body. Completely reproduces color coding. We have pursued to the utmost the separation of parts for easy assembly without any visible seams.
• Recreate the interior of the first hangar. The hatch of the second hangar can be opened and closed. Compatible reproduction of opening and closing of the third hangar.
• 4 types of carrier-based aircraft of the same scale x 2 are included.
• Marking including details is reproduced with slide marks.
Molded product x undetermined, slide mark, assembly manual
